prompt: The root-mean-square speed of neon atoms (mass of one atom m = 3.35 x 10^-26 kg) in a container is 610 m s^-1. Calculate the thermodynamic temperature T of the gas. Take k = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1.

mark_scheme.criterion: Uses (1/2) m c_rms^2 = (3/2) kT to give T = (m c_rms^2) / (3k).

hints: Equate kinetic energy (1/2) m c_rms^2 with (3/2) kT.
Rearrange to make T the subject: T = (m c_rms^2) / (3k).
teacher_walkthrough: Rearrange (1/2) m c_rms^2 = (3/2) kT for temperature: T = m c_rms^2 / (3k).
Substitute m = 3.35 x 10^-26 kg, c_rms = 610 m s^-1, and k = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1.
